# Auren

> Auren is an independent software company. Its site explains how workflow automation connects applications, APIs and AI models to automate routine business work, and presents Zent, Auren's server-monitoring product.

## Pages

- [Auren home](https://www.auren.rest/): workflow-automation use cases, an interactive simulated order-fulfilment workflow, company overview and products.
- [Workflow explorer](https://www.auren.rest/#explorer): Step-by-step simulated order workflow (webhook, validation, payment, inventory, decision, robot simulation, update, confirmation) with failure branches.

## Products

- [Zent](https://zent.auren.rest/): Server monitoring by Auren. Capabilities on www.auren.rest describe intended scope; availability is labelled individually.

## Key facts

- Workflow automation connects apps, APIs, AI models and databases.
- The robotic fulfilment cell and order workflow on www.auren.rest are simulations. No real orders, payments, inventory updates, live workflow engines or robot hardware are connected.
- Use cases covered: e-commerce order processing, inventory synchronisation, invoice generation, customer notifications, daily reports, lead follow-up, AI document processing, scheduled data collection.
